scope: Stationary desktop native counter observation, five 30-second paired setting repeats and a separate single-arm 1800-second longevity observation.
verified: Template arms differ in exactly Graphics.InternalResolution (1 versus 2); shared main configuration bytes are identical; frameskip is zero and automatic frameskip is false.
Every run starts a fresh native process, copies the same state hash and arm configuration, and waits 10 seconds before counter collection; arm order alternates AB/BA.
First-pair private screenshots independently show the same Soldier office/motorcycle scene; increased edge sharpness corroborates the declared resolution change.
First five completed raw observations independently recompute to the recorded arithmetic means, each with 30 native response samples inside the nominal 30-second window and a zero process exit.
At 19:07:12.587943 UTC, pair-4-2x PID30521 was the only PPSSPPSDL process and owned port 19362 listening inode138924; its /proc executable hash matched the reviewed corrected build.
Both package builds and the full test suite completed before pair1 started; the last package build ended 19:00:52.783041 UTC, pair1 started 19:02:25.427033 UTC.
All 11 imported runs validate against the existing gameplay importer, frozen template hashes, scene/environment identities, private raw hashes and original receipt binary/state identities.
All per-run means and final five-pair comparison independently recompute exactly. Original pair4 raw observations remain retained and are absent from selected comparison.
Both replacement pair4 process receipts independently checked for expected executable hash, sole native child and port 19362 listener ownership; timestamps follow completed soak.
The single soak contains 1,748 samples, observed 1800.001647999 seconds, normal exit 0, and maximum adjacent counter response gap 1.043940986 seconds. This was a contended host longevity observation.

The separate 1200-second resource segment has 241 samples and matches the soak PID/starttime/identity. Peak memory and CPU summaries recompute; approximate segment 19:15:44.486538–19:35:44.491112UTC lies within the soak.
All 13 retained private WAV file hashes and container headers match the exported inventory; readable frame counts agree. This does not add auditory quality evidence.

corrections_required.finding: Three native negative probes overlapped pair4-2x. The original environment description of no concurrent native process is inaccurate for that interval. Preserve originals as excluded and repeat both pair4 arms without competing native work.
corrections_required.interval_method: Native agent reconstructed from experiment receipt mtime minus monotonic elapsed duration; these are approximate wall-clock intervals, not directly logged UTC boundaries. Independent ps output observed pair4 child and truncated-matching-hash child concurrently.
corrections_required.resolution: Both original pair4 arms remain under excluded/. Replacement 2x then 1x ran after the soak and all other native sessions ended, using frozen original configuration bytes; sole-process, executable digest and listener ownership assertions passed. Both exited 0.

corrections_required.finding: Importer requires exactly equal declared durations and observation windows. Observer observed_seconds includes final status request overhead and differs slightly across runs. Define the common 30-second analysis window separately from acquisition duration; preserve raw timing and observed_seconds without rounding away the distinction. Reject any sample outside the declared common window.

specific_observation.required_action: Filter response snapshots to declared common [0,30) analysis window and recompute imported sample means; retain original acquisition summary unchanged. This leaves 29 samples for this run. The other nine original runs have 30 snapshots inside that window.

corrections_required.resolution: Importer filters each raw response by the retained status-start anchored [0,duration) window and recomputes means. Pair5-2x includes 29 of 30 responses; all other selected runs have no excluded responses. Actual acquisition durations remain separate and unrounded.

limits: Host x86_64 Mesa software rendering, Xvfb, four-CPU cgroup quota and SDL dummy audio are not TrimUI performance evidence.
The same shared-memory isolation and optional discovery shim is injected into both arms; observations describe this shimmed host runtime.

Observer code does not itself bind its websocket to a process. Replacement pair4 has explicit child executable/sole-process/listener assertions; original pair4 and the soak have independent live socket receipts. Earlier selected repeats rely on sequential child execution plus matching game/version, binary/configuration identities and native logs.

Measurement origin is recorded indirectly through the preceding retained game.status response. measure_start occurs just afterward, with a small unrecorded Python overhead; response acquisition after the nominal window is separately included in observed_seconds.

Native sampled FPS and vblank speed are distinct, unweighted means of counter snapshots. The speed denominator comes from the endpoint (60/1.001), not assumed panel refresh. Poll cadence includes response latency and is approximately one second.
Frame history arrays overlap and are not used for percentile estimates. Panel frame pacing, audible output quality, input latency, battery and device thermals remain unmeasured.
The single-arm stationary soak is a longevity observation; it cannot satisfy matched sustained-arm or demanding-gameplay qualification.
The scene and state are fixed, but this is a stationary short scene without representative traversal/combat/loading coverage. No preset recommendation follows from it.
Native control-config creation/save warnings and unavailable Vulkan preflight messages are retained; the selected backend is OpenGL and completed processes exit zero.
Private scene images, game data, states and WAV files are excluded from repository evidence; hashes identify retained private originals.

Pinned Display.cpp CalculateFPS assigns actualFps from the count of flips since its previous update after at least one second, without normalizing that count by elapsed time; the VPS counter does normalize elapsed time. Tiny native FPS mean differences around 30 reflect counter window quantization and do not establish a performance gain.
Replacement pair4 was collected after the other pairs and soak; its later timing is explicit. This shared host lacks device clocks, thermal controls and a preregistered performance budget.
The resource segment covers 1200 seconds of the 1800-second soak and is never attached as full-soak resource coverage. Point samples and RSS growth cannot prove or exclude a leak.
No title/load, moving on-foot, driving or action matched comparison, paired demanding soak, composed frontend comparison or actual hardware run was added.
decision: Final selected stationary host observations and importer results are internally consistent and independently verified. G06 remains partial against the broader roadmap; no device, demanding-profile, audio-quality or speed-improvement qualification.
